Overview
Tulloch Castle dates from the 12th century, when the Bains and later the Clan Davidson laid claim to its lands. Like its lively history, the castle s fortunes have changed many times. Now, it stands as a magnificent hotel, with a ready welcome for leisure and business travellers.
The castle retains many of its period features, including the 250-year-old panelled Great Hall, and painstakingly restored original fireplaces and ceilings.
In days of old, only the Laird or the Chief of the Clan could enjoy a relaxing stay in a Scottish highland castle. Thankfully, times have changed. Today, Tulloch Castle has 22 well-appointed en suite  bedrooms , each with their own unique character and charm. Guests are given a warm welcome, and can expect splendid hospitality, comfortable surroundings and superb food.
Complimentary on-site parking is available for hotel guests, with no booking required.
Dogs are welcome in all bedrooms and the Green Lady Bar, with a charge of £15 per dog, per night. Please note that dogs are not permitted in Turrets Restaurant.
Frequently Asked Questions
Find helpful information about check-in and check-out, dining, parking, dogs, accessibility, family stays, hotel facilities and more in our Frequently Asked Questions .

Overview
Originally designed and built in the 19th century, the Arrochar Hotel is one of the most enviably positioned hotels in Argyll and Bute. It is based at the very foot of the ‘Arrochar Alps’ on the shores of Loch Long, only two miles from Loch Lomond.
With 76 comfortable en suite bedrooms that offer stunning views, as well as a beautifully positioned suite, it makes for an idyllic tranquil hideaway to relax and unwind, and also as an ideal base to explore the beautiful countryside, Loch Lomond and the Western Highlands and Islands.

Overview
Located in the historic former premises of the Duchess High School, the Bailiffgate Hotel is an iconic building at the heart of Alnwick overlooking the Barbican entrance to Alnwick Castle, which since Norman times has been a constant presence in the landscape.  The hotel features 48 bedrooms, suites and apartments, as well as a stylish bar and restaurant together with a private dining space.
From the moment you arrive, you’ll be embraced by the warmth of Northumbrian hospitality, where every detail has been thoughtfully considered. Unwind in our elegant rooms, indulge in locally inspired cuisine, and relax in spaces that reflect the area’s unique heritage. With breathtaking views and luxury features, Bailiffgate Hotel invites you to sit back, relax, and let us take care of the rest!
Dog Friendly
We love dogs and we’re delighted to welcome your well-behaved pets to stay in our dog-friendly rooms. With scenic countryside and beaches nearby, your furry friend will have plenty to explore and enjoy.
There’s a small charge of £30 for your dog’s first night, and £25 for each additional night. We’ll provide everything they need for a comfortable and enjoyable stay at Bailiffgate Hotel.
Guests must contact the hotel before booking to check there is a dog-friendly room available.
Dogs are also welcome in selected locations in both the Motte & Bailey restaurant and the Commissioner’s Bar – we just kindly ask that they remain on leads and off the furniture during your visit.
Visiting Alnwick, (pronounced ‘anick’), is
like stepping into a fairytale, where you can
fly a broomstick at Alnwick Castle (star
location for Hogwarts in the Harry Potter
movies), dine in the twinkling treetops of
one of the world’s largest treehouses and visit
a winking giant at The Alnwick Garden.
Alnwick is a beautiful market town in
Northumberland, England, of which it is the
traditional county town. The town sits on the
south bank of the River Aln, 32 miles south
of Berwick-upon-Tweed and the Scottish
border, and 34 miles north of Newcastle
upon Tyne.

Overview
HOTEL NOW OPEN!
GOLF AND WELLNESS OPENING MID OCTOBER 2026.
A destination shaped around rest, play and good living.
Set within the Buckinghamshire countryside in Boarstall, near Aylesbury, Bicester and Oxford, Bernwood Park offers the ease of a countryside retreat with everything needed for a memorable stay stylish bedrooms, a scenic golf course, relaxed food and drink, spa experiences and space to simply breathe.
Whether visiting for a weekend break, a golf escape, a long lunch or time spent unwinding with friends and family, Bernwood Park is designed to feel relaxed, welcoming and quietly restorative.
Parking
We have a large tarmacked car park on-site for guests. Dedicated accessible parking bays are also available close to the Hotel entrance.
EV charging points are available on site; however, they are not yet operational. We are working to have them commissioned and available for guest use as soon as possible.
In the meantime, we recommend planning an alternative charging stop before your arrival.

wikipedia.title: Tulloch Castle
wikipedia.extract: Tulloch Castle is located in the town of Dingwall in the Highlands of Scotland. It dates at least to the late 14th century as the birthplace of Mariota Leslie, daughter of Euphemia I, countess of Ross. Mariota was the wife of Donald Macdonald, Lord of the Isles. Several of Euphemia's children by Walter Leslie were born at Tulloch Castle.
